description.zh: 把 Bitwarden / Vaultwarden 接进 DSH。设置页提供 Bitwarden 扩展风格的密码库：搜索、类型筛选、按文件夹分组、详情查看、新建与编辑。AI 只能检索条目元数据，密码通过受控执行通道注入子进程使用，明文不进入对话或会话日志；带本地审计日志与空闲自动锁定。
description.en: Connect a Bitwarden or Vaultwarden vault to DSH. The Settings page offers a Bitwarden-extension-style vault: search, type filters, folder grouping, details, create and edit. The agent only reads item metadata; passwords are used through a controlled execution channel and never enter the conversation or session log, with a local audit log and idle auto-lock.
